sections.description: Theme-independent direct comment reply emails with explicit consent, configurable branding, and queued delivery.
sections.changelog:
= 0.9.2 =
* Receive the licensing connection through the existing GitHub updater. Connect once under Settings → MTT updates for future official updates; installed features keep working.
* Show a clear connection status, shorter setup help and update access for installed plugins only.

= 0.9.1 =
* Use the shared MTT admin UI library for consistent controls, layouts and keyboard focus.

* Report protected update outcomes through the shared website connection without sending content or credentials.

= 0.9.0 =
* Share one website key across MTT plugins with encrypted storage and manual site approval.
* Protect official update delivery while keeping installed features working.

= 0.5.1 =
* Load the checkbox stylesheet only when the reply opt-in appears in a comment form.
* Coordinate reply delivery with Modern Comments through explicit engine ownership, preserving subscriptions and signed links.
* Keep the integrated reply engine synchronized with this canonical source during validation and packaging.
* Add the shared MTT brand mark to the settings heading with local assets and reserved dimensions.
* Group reply settings into Comment form, Email design, and Delivery & data with one Save changes button and preserved drafts.
* Add editable checkbox label/helper text, neutral appearance controls, and a live checkbox preview using the public renderer.
* Add an explicit, dry-run-first migration for approved legacy GP opt-ins without historical emails.

= 0.5.0 =
* Add a styled comment opt-in with configurable label, optional helper text, color, size and native-control alternative.
* Preview unsaved checkbox changes beside the controls without saving settings or sending email.
* Organize Comment form, Email design, and Delivery & data into accessible tabs with one Save changes action that preserves edits across tabs.
* Inherit theme typography, retain theme overrides, and preserve subscription and email-branding data.

= 0.4.9 =
* Activate checked comment-form opt-ins immediately for guests and members, without a confirmation email.
* Preserve unchecked choices, unsubscribe links, moderation checks and address-change verification.

= 0.4.8 =
* After explicit guest confirmation, queue up to 20 recent approved direct replies posted while the current subscription was pending.
* Preserve moderation, self-reply suppression, unsubscribe checks, identity boundaries and idempotent delivery; do not send catch-up mail during upgrades.

= 0.4.7 =
* Combine audience event reporting with the shared reply integration and uninstall protection from 0.4.6.
* Preserve shorter form wording, saved consent labels, and existing reply subscriptions.

= 0.4.6 =
* Preserve shared reply data and schedules when uninstalled while Comment Highlights 0.8 or later is active.
* Retain the shorter default opt-in wording and existing custom consent labels alongside the combined reply system.

= 0.4.5 =
* Shorten the default reply opt-in and unsubscribe guidance without changing checkbox behavior or site-authored consent wording.
* Shorten the default reply opt-in to “Email me when someone replies.” and helper text to “Unsubscribe anytime.”
* Apply the shorter wording to the original saved default while preserving custom consent labels, opt-out choice and guest email confirmation.

= 0.4.4 =
* Add shared, pseudonymous audience events with deduplication, 90-day retention and WordPress privacy export/erasure.

= 0.4.3 =
* Preserve shared reply data and schedules when uninstalled while Comment Highlights 0.8 or later is active.

= 0.4.2 =
* Start the comment-form notification checkbox checked when notifications are enabled.
* Preserve the ability to uncheck it and mandatory anonymous email confirmation.
* Clarify the default in notification settings and privacy-policy guidance.

= 0.4.1 =
* Show the brand name only when no logo is configured in HTML emails and previews.

= 0.4.0 =
* Added a live email design workspace with reply and confirmation previews, sample subjects, and mobile/desktop views.
* Preview draft branding safely without saving settings or sending email.

= 0.3.2 =
* Display the official Made to Thrive circle badge in WordPress plugin updates.

= 0.3.1 =
* Use the plugin name without an MTT prefix; retain Made to Thrive authorship and the handwritten mtt icon.

= 0.3.0 =
* Added the canonical MTT release channel, a dedicated settings page, and a saved branding preview.
* Preserved existing subscription IDs, consent records, settings, signing keys, and Save to Email branding integration.
* Hardened malformed settings input and removed legacy standalone release tooling.

= 0.2.0 =
* Added configurable brand name, Media Library logo, colors, footer text, branded email, and matching confirmation/unsubscribe pages.
* Made anonymous confirmation mandatory and protected consent when a comment address changes.
* Added stale-event and per-recipient delivery limits, stronger rate limiting, schema verification, and clearer mail failures.
* Expanded consent evidence, inactive-data retention, privacy export/erase behavior, Site Health diagnostics, and integration tests.

= 0.1.0 =
* Initial private release.
* Added direct reply opt-in, optional anonymous confirmation, queued delivery, multipart email, signed confirmation/unsubscribe actions, administration, privacy tools, Site Health checks, and WP-CLI queue commands.

== Upgrade Notice ==

= 0.4.9 =
New checked comment-form opt-ins activate without email confirmation. Existing pending requests and address-change verification are preserved.

= 0.2.0 =

Review the new reply-notification branding settings and privacy-policy suggestion. Anonymous commenters now always confirm their address before notifications become active.
